material.value: Does a region container in a new overlay slot inherit a transform (containing block for fixed children) from #ui-modal, #ui-centre or #ui-top?
material.witness_evidence: Only the named hosts carry transforms: #ui-top, #ui-centre, #ui-modal (widgets.js STYLE, dispatch 1792909897564-5425-fcf419c297a5df9c). hostFor() creates any other slot as ui-<slot> with class w-overlay (position fixed, no transform), so a slot named full is a clean full-screen host.
